jobs.description:
Cruising down the road with your favorite music on, but always in for a friendly chat at the door? That’s exactly what your day looks like as an Albert Heijn delivery driver!

You get to enjoy some peaceful "me-time" behind the wheel. But once you arrive at the customer’s doorstep? It’s time for a warm smile and a quick, happy chat!

Curious about what else this awesome job has in store for you? #jobtip 🚀 Read all about it below!

What we offer
- Bring a friend and get € 200!
- After 13 weeks € 18,83 per hour
- Travel allowance
- Opportunities to become a senior driver
- Weekly pay and a pension plan
- A pleasant, informal work atmosphere

Who you are
As a delivery driver at Albert Heijn, you are the hero who delivers groceries right to the customer’s door. You are physically fit and can easily lift crates up to 15 kilos. You recognize yourself in the following:

- You speak Dutch or English;
- You have transportation to get to Nijverheidsweg 73A in Amersfoort;
- You have a valid B driving license (stick shift).

What will you do
You start your day with a quick check of the van. After that you pick up your delivery routes of the day. Of you go! From city streets to hidden roads in small villages. As a driver for Albert Heijn in Amersfoort you never know what to expect.  No worries, you keep it cool because you got well-prepared during your training period!

Besides delivering, there are also growth opportunities at Albert Heijn. Become a buddy and guide new colleagues during their first working days. Or take the step to become a senior driver, ensuring every driver is perfectly prepared for their route.

- Flexible hours from 06:00–14:00 or 14:00–23:00.
- You can work part-time or full-time from Monday to Sunday, with at least two Saturdays per month.

Are you looking for a flexible job that fits perfectly into your life? Become an Uber Eats delivery courier!

Decide when you work, cycle through the city, and earn money while doing it. With Uber Eats, you enjoy the freedom to work on your own terms. 

What are you going to do?
As a courier for Uber Eats, you’ll be the link between restaurants and hungry customers.

Your main tasks are:

- Navigating the fastest route using the Uber Eats app
- Delivering with a smile and punctuality – keeping customers happy and well-fed

What do we offer?
- Salary: Starting at €16,19 gross/hour (age 21+), including holiday pay
- Peak earnings: Up to € 21,19 gross/hour with daily bonuses and and keep 100% of your tips
- Gear: We provide the necessary gear to keep you safe and comfortable during delivery
- Benefits: 20 paid vacation days + pension contributions from day one
- Flexible schedule: Plan all of your work, yourself through your phone beforehand. We do not set your work schedule

Where will you work?
Join Uber Eats and become part of a global leader in food delivery that offers flexible work opportunities, competitive earnings, and the freedom to choose your own schedule. Whether you're looking for full-time or part-time work, Uber Eats provides a simple way to earn while delivering food and connecting communities. and flexibility. Our shared goal is for all our deliveries to be emission-free by 2040. 

Be part of a movement that’s changing the way the world eats.

What do we ask?
To start as a delivery courier with Uber Eats, you must meet the following conditions:

•            You are at least 16 years old

•            You live in the Netherlands

•            You speak either Dutch or English

•            You have a smartphone with an internet connection

•            You have your own bicycle, e-bike, or scooter

*Please note: delivery using a car, e-step (electric scooter), or any other vehicle is not allowed
